title: TanStack Query
definition: TanStack (React) Query is a powerful asynchronous state management library. It abstracts away data fetching, caching, synchronization, background updates, and error handling for Server State.
simpleExplanation: Instead of manually writing `useEffect` fetches and saving data to `useState`, React Query handles the fetching, caching, loading spinners, and automatic background refreshing for you.

basic: How does TanStack Query fundamentally work?
